Ouisync CLI 0.10.2 third-party dependency notices
Source revision: v0.10.2 (ee4dffce2fb5458a821afef14a41d77abbc85926), modified by LANLauncherNG.
Modifications: the MPL-2.0 covered source files changed by LANLauncherNG (lib/src/store/block.rs, lib/src/store/client.rs) are provided as a patch against that revision in `LLNG-MODIFICATIONS.patch` in this directory. The change saves re-received leaf nodes of locally stored blocks as present, so read replicas do not stall below 100% after repository updates.
Build features: Linux x86_64 and Windows x86_64 include the `vfs` feature (FUSE and Dokan respectively). The Windows package also includes the Dokan 2.3.0.1000 runtime DLL and official x64 MSI driver installer. `VCRUNTIME140.dll` is redistributed from the bundled CPython 3.14.0 runtime under its Microsoft Distributable Code terms, included in `vendor/licenses/python/LICENSE.txt`.
